biomarkers.name: NOTCH1 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Prognostic (worse); target for gamma-secretase inhibitors and Notch-directed therapy in trials

biomarkers.name: KIT (CD117)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports diagnosis; not consistently predictive of imatinib response

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Biphasic — luminal ductal + basal/myoepithelial cells; characteristic cribriform 'Swiss cheese' pattern
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Percentage of solid component (grade III when >30% solid); perineural invasion is characteristic and prognostic

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Distinctive basement membrane-like material in cribriform spaces (reduplicated basement membrane)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Intercalated duct cells + myoepithelial cells (bipotent progenitors)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Biphasic — luminal ductal + basal/myoepithelial cells; recapitulates normal intercalated duct architecture
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: MYB-NFIB fusion drives the characteristic biphasic differentiation and neurotropic behaviour
